capabilities: embed a website in a note via a 'browser' code block
interact with the embedded page (scroll, click)
configure the embed height in settings
show an inline error when a URL is invalid or the site blocks embedding
extras: Desktop only; the README warns that many sites block embedding via X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy and shows a ⚠️ Could not load page error.
problem: Obsidian notes can't display a working webpage inline; users must switch to a browser to view or interact with a site.
summary: Embeds any website as a live, interactive browser view inside a note via a 'browser' fenced code block with a URL.
